pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal and sub-rhomboidal dark regions with moderately sharp edge gradients. Individual patches show irregular, non-uniform spatial distribution across the lateral flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light interstitial pathways forming a lattice-like topology. Nodes are primarily tri-radial with consistent pixel thickness across the central flank region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency vertical protrusions along the upper neck and shoulder silhouette, creating a jagged 1D geometric contour.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian organism (oxpecker) perched on the posterior dorsal ridge.
